Exit code 143 = SIGTERM. Did `pkill -f "node dist/apps/startuphafen-backend/main.js"` match the shell's own command line? No — pkill -f matches other processes. Exit code 143 suggests the shell itself got killed. Probably because `pkill -f "nx serve startuphafen-frontend"` matched the bash process's command line (the bash -c that contains this string!). Since the command string contains "nx serve startuphafen-frontend", pkill -f ended up killing its own shell. A classic mistake.
